title: Gaea Canyon snowfall: neutral exterior, orange muzzle and stronger dither
input_audit: Disclosed combat-lighting fixture: place the Tiger on a viable route point near 180 m from the seeded first 45 mm gun, mark the engagement begun, and lay its gun on that gun. Two disclosed loaded discharges. Live Soviet movement, aiming, projectiles and damage; no invulnerability. Head-out ride and ordinary low driving input. This is not an autonomous full Canyon attempt.
historical_scope: The CANYON playtest course (docs/CANYON_COURSE_20260929.md): a composite of Stalingrad's balkas with a workers' settlement and a factory edge, held by a rifle battalion's 45 mm guns and two T-34 platoons; a playtest course, not a recorded engagement.
